beats.description: Deliver Erin's package to Selys at the Adventurer's Guild.
Decide what to do with Selys's reward.
Find out what happened to Krshia's missing crate near the south-square sewers.
Tell Krshia what became of her crate.

quests._comment: Content Wave C3 Quest 1, three-path parity (crate precedent). Beat 1 `resolve` is the SHARED convergence counter `resolved_the_cisterns`, banked by ANY path: FIGHT (shield_spiders on_victory), TALK (Zevara sweep option), or SKILL (banked at Olesm's intel-report, since [Appraise Foe] alone only banks scouted_the_nest). Beat 2 `report` (`cisterns_reported`) is Olesm's completion, banked at report time on all three paths (the SKILL report banks resolve+report together, firing both beats at once -- crate guile precedent). heard_about_cisterns (the grate-gate + quest-start) is NOT a beat; it only opens the door.
quests.title: Something in the Cisterns

beats.description: Settle whatever has nested in the cisterns beneath the market -- however you see fit.
Report the outcome to Olesm at the Guild.

quests._comment: Content Wave C4 Quest 2 'The Wrong Order' (Lyonette, social). Three-path parity mirroring the cisterns two-beat shape. Beat 1 `resolve` is the SHARED convergence counter `resolved_wrong_order`, banked by ANY path: FIGHT-adjacent (supplier_scavengers on_victory), TALK (Krshia smooth-over option), or SKILL (banked at Lyonette's report, since cooking alone only banks stretched_the_order -- cisterns_scout precedent). Beat 2 `report` (`wrong_order_reported`) is Lyonette's gratitude beat, banked at report time on all three paths (the SKILL report banks resolve+report together, firing both beats at once). heard_wrong_order (the quest-start) is NOT a beat; it only opens the give-beat and starts the quest.
quests.title: The Wrong Order

beats.description: Set Lyonette's botched supply order right -- strong-arm, sweet-talk, or stretch it in the kitchen.
Tell Lyonette it's handled, before Erin hears of it.

quests._comment: Magical Door plan Task D3 (issue #8, milestone 8a spec §5 RATIFIED earn-shape). Beat 1 'the flicker' (door_chain_started, Erin's post-epilogue line, erin_errand.json) starts the quest but is NOT itself a beat (heard_about_cisterns/heard_wrong_order precedent -- it only opens the mage-consult gate). Beat 'consult' is the SHARED convergence counter door_understood, banked by ANY of Pisces's 3-path mage consult (FIGHT: clear rift_vermin_leak in the inn; TALK: persuade Pisces to examine it himself; SKILL: read the doorframe's wardwork with [Observe] and report back -- pisces_magic.json). Beat 'recover' requires BOTH recovered_anchor_stone (the ruin run's anchor_stone_pedestal, gated open via the internal pedestal_unsealed convergence counter -- cleared_ruin_guardian OR either of the TALK/SKILL door_understood legs) AND bought_catalyst (Krshia's resonant_catalyst, 35g, her charms buy node) -- spec §5.3's 'ruin + Krshia ONLY' attunement components, both order-independent (either can be earned first). D4 (issue #8 Task D4) consumes this chain's completion to start the study-sleeps counter toward the awakening beat; door_that_goes_elsewhere has no further beats here by design (awakening/the portal menu are D4's own sim surface, not a quest beat).
quests.title: The Door That Goes Elsewhere

beats.description: Find out what's happening with the pantry door -- fight it, talk to Pisces, or read the wardwork yourself.
Recover the anchor stone from the ruin and buy Krshia's catalyst to attune it.
